text:
Iris: hi all, on my first-day checklist trying to view the 'model-serving' Grafana but the annotation row is empty for the last 48h. panels show latency but no deploy markers. who owns the deploy-event source?
Ben: welcome! :wave: annotations come from Datadog events (we tag them source:deploy service:model-serving). are you hitting the prod grafana or staging?
Iris: prod at https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pm3-model-serving. I can see the graphs but no annotations.
obs-bot: Welcome to Redwood! Don’t forget to submit the Observability access form: https://go/redwood/obs-access
Sophie: hey Iris, quick debug steps: 1) check Datadog Events view (search service:model-serving source:deploy), 2) open Grafana panel -> Annotations to confirm the datasource and filter, 3) ask eng-observability if Grafana's datadog API key rotated.
Iris: I see events in Datadog (e.g. dd-event-77821 "deploy model-serving v1.14 -> prod"). Grafana annotation panel filter is "source = deploy AND tags:service = model-serving".
Ben: ok that means either Grafana's Datadog datasource lacks events:read or the grafana-service-account key is invalid. Sophie can you check recent rotations?
Sophie: checking... grafana-service-account key was rotated yesterday; secret updated in vault but Grafana still had the old key until a manual sync. I see 403s in grafana logs when it queries datadog for events.
Iris: is there a workaround? I need deploy markers to correlate a spike.
Sophie: I can manually add a Grafana annotation for the specific deploys you care about, or temporarily bind the folder to a staging datasource that uses the updated key. Which do you prefer?
Iris: manual annotations fine for now. Also I can wait for the key fix if it's quick.
Sophie: I'll rotate the key in Grafana now and reload the datasource. Ben, can you confirm there are no network egress rules blocking Grafana -> Datadog?
Ben: no network blocks. Sophie rotated the key and reloaded the datasource  done — should be live in ~30s. Iris try a hard refresh.
Iris: annotations appeared! I can see dd-event-77821 and two earlier deploys. thanks!
Sophie: great. One more note for future hires: if you want to test annotations without touching prod, post a staging Datadog event with tags ["service:model-serving","source:deploy"] and use staging grafana (link in the new-hire docs). Also include required obs-access ticket if you need Datadog project access.
Iris: posted a staging event and verified staging grafana picks it up. Datadog project invite still pending in obs ticket #11022.
Ben: that ticket will grant Datadog 'events:read' and Sentry 'project:reader' after identity mapping. If it stalls >24h ping this thread and we'll escalate.
Iris: thanks everyone, super fast help. excited to be here :tada:
thread_text_short: New hire Iris can't see deploy annotations; Sophie discovers rotated Grafana Datadog API key, rotates and reloads datasource; annotations return; staging test verified.
